purpose: Independent fixed-sample confirmation of weak-Landau duration, C4 rate fidelity, and same-campaign noise benefit after correcting the v1 velocity-support failure

historical_global_campaign.use: original window diagnosis and campaign design only

failed_v1_campaign.use: loading-admissibility failure diagnosis only; never pooled or used for v2 inference
failed_v1_campaign.failure: the repeated per-cell 32-point longitudinal velocity support ended below the resonant phase velocity

global_loading_pilot.use: pre-v2 implementation pilot only; never pooled into v2

confirmation.pairing: For each seed, initialize one PPC-1024 particle state and byte-copy x,y,vx,vy,w into all three arms; save and compare SHA-256 digests.

benchmark.velocity_loading: global inverse-normal quiet-start template, independently shuffled for vx and vy over all particles with the frozen seed
benchmark.velocity_assignment_scope: global over 1048576 PPC-1024 particles; not a repeated per-cell velocity tensor
benchmark.velocity_support_check: 1048576 distinct unperturbed longitudinal nodes, |vx|max=4.9009642134, 690 nodes at or above v_phase=3.2126424241
benchmark.spatial_particle_loading: regular 2048 by 512 marker lattice before perturbation displacement, exactly 1024 particles in every 64 by 16 field-grid cell

time_integration.integrator: electrostatic velocity-Verlet with two force evaluations per step

field_solver.algorithm: numpy rfft2 periodic spectral Poisson solve
field_solver.equations: phi_hat=rho_hat/k^2 for k!=0; Ex_hat=-i*kx*phi_hat; Ey_hat=-i*ky*phi_hat; k=0 set to zero
field_solver.particle_field_chain: CIC deposit -> W on rho -> spectral Poisson -> same W on Ex,Ey -> CIC gather

arms.name: Gaussian C4 constrained setting
arms.directional_convention: cell-isotropic: sigma_x=1.0*dx and sigma_y=1.0*dy; W is applied once on deposition and once on the return field

arms.name: Previously selected exact LOO-CV comparator
arms.directional_convention: cell-isotropic: sigma_x=7.244293147028428*dx and sigma_y=7.244293147028428*dy; W is applied once on deposition and once on the return field
arms.selection_source: landau_lscv_static_5008392, alpha=0.01, PPC 1024, ten global-layout development seeds, exact particle-phase-averaged CIC LOO self term, t=0 static selection
arms.selection_independence_note: The width was selected before v2 from disjoint static data under the same global velocity-assignment convention and is never reselected from v2 rates.

fit_rule.observable: abs(mean over seeds of the complex Ex Fourier coefficient at mode (1,0)))
fit_rule.operation_order: average complex coefficients, then magnitude, then centered one-period geometric envelope, then one log-linear slope
fit_rule.fit_t_stop_rationale: The cap is frozen above 35.2444, the time needed for two amplitude e-foldings from t=5 at the verified reference magnitude, with 9.76 additional time units of margin.
fit_rule.noise_floor_estimator: minimum rolling median of the centered envelope over complete five-time-unit windows stepped by one time unit
fit_rule.accepted_end_rule: Use the last diagnostic strictly before first_persistent_5x_floor_crossing_index minus 24 centered-envelope look-ahead samples; if no crossing occurs, use the lesser of t=45 and simulation end.
fit_rule.recurrence_and_distortion_policy: They are recorded as post-fit diagnostics, not used to shorten the interval. A resulting signal-quality failure is a campaign failure; the interval is not tuned after looking at the rate ratio.
fit_rule.recurrence_diagnostic: After the accepted endpoint and before t=70, flag the first run of five samples for which log(envelope[t])-log(envelope[t-one_period]) is nonnegative. This flag never changes the accepted endpoint.
fit_rule.envelope_distortion_diagnostic: Flag when accepted-fit R^2 is below 0.90. This is a signal-quality failure and never triggers a shorter refit.
fit_rule.bootstrap_pairing: resample the same seed indices in CIC and the comparison arm; use the pre-recorded central accepted window for each arm

numerical_reference.kind: fully discrete principal-mode prediction with CIC, midpoint time stepping, spatial aliases and temporal aliases converged through lmax=1024
numerical_reference.gate: the 95% interval for abs(gamma_CIC)/abs(gamma_fully_discrete) must lie wholly within [0.90,1.10]

requirements: CIC central accepted fit has at least 2.0 fitted amplitude e-foldings
C4 central accepted fit has at least 2.0 fitted amplitude e-foldings
CIC and C4 each pass fit-start SNR>=5, R^2>=0.90, minimum-points and minimum-duration checks
at least 80% of paired bootstrap draws pass the frozen signal and fit-quality checks in both arms
the CIC absolute-rate 95% interval lies wholly inside the predeclared 10% fully-discrete reference budget
the paired 95% interval for gamma_C4/gamma_CIC lies wholly inside [0.90,1.10]
all 40 fresh seeds are present exactly once, every three-arm particle hash matches within seed, and all raw histories and configuration/source hashes are recorded
promotion_rule.pooled_development_plus_confirmation_ana: forbidden for the primary result; any separately requested pooled result must be labeled secondary

same_campaign_noise_metrics.reference: PPC-4096 unfiltered CIC run with the same global inverse-normal velocity-assignment protocol and seed identifier, generated independently for each of the 40 v2 seeds
same_campaign_noise_metrics.density_error_power: mean over all grid nodes of (rho_arm-rho_reference)^2 after the arm deposition filter; k=0 and protected mode are retained (the matched total charge makes the k=0 difference zero up to roundoff)
same_campaign_noise_metrics.field_error_power: mean over all grid nodes of [(Ex_arm-Ex_reference)^2+(Ey_arm-Ey_reference)^2] after deposition filtering and Poisson solve, before the return-path W and before particle gather; k=0 field is zero and every nonzero resolved mode, including (1,0), is retained
same_campaign_noise_metrics.reduction_ratio: ratio of the ensemble-and-time mean CIC error power to the corresponding candidate error power
same_campaign_noise_metrics.amplitude_variance_power_note: Both metrics are squared-error powers. They are neither amplitude attenuation nor particle-force error.
same_campaign_noise_metrics.reference_limit: The finite PPC-4096 reference has residual sampling error; report it and do not call it an exact continuum field.

reporting_order: presence, hashes, loading support, and pairing checks
accepted start/end and exact end reason for CIC, C4, and comparator
same-campaign density and field error-power results
single-run traces separately from coherent-ensemble validation

analysis_lock.stage_1: Write and hash window_decisions.json containing each arm's accepted interval and ending reason; compute no rate ratios.
analysis_lock.stage_2: Refuse comparative analysis unless the stage-1 file and every input history hash match; use those accepted intervals unchanged for central and paired-bootstrap rates.
